title: Will EIA's South Dakota-region residential propane price exceed $2.00/gallon in October 2026?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if the U.S. Energy Information Administration's Weekly Heating Oil and Propane Prices report (eia.gov/petroleum/heatingoilpropane) shows a South Dakota / PADD 2 state-level residential propane price above $2.00 per gallon in any weekly release published during October 2026; NO otherwise.
falsifier: Wrong if EIA's own published weekly price table for October 2026 disagrees with the recorded probability's implied side.
